Package com.nexuslink.ui.s3

Class S3FileSystem

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.ui.s3.S3FileSystem
All Implemented Interfaces:
FileSystem, FileTransfer
public final class S3FileSystem extends Object implements FileSystem, FileTransfer
Adapts S3Service to the generic FileSystem/FileTransfer contracts so an S3-compatible object store drives one pane of the DualPaneBrowser — the same WinSCP-style commander (transfer queue, drag-and-drop, quick-view) used for SFTP/FTP.

The bucket list is the root; buckets and common prefixes appear as folders and objects as files, with all the path math in the pure ObjectPath. S3 has no native rename, so that one operation is unsupported (copy-then-delete would be needed); everything else — list, mkdir (folder marker), delete (recursive), upload, download, and in-place content read/write — maps onto the service.
